claim.quote: We confirm the H.E.S.S. results about the morphology and the energy spectrum, and find the energy spectrum in the NW-rim is consistent with that of the whole remnant.

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; journal reference as printed on the arXiv page: Astrophys.J.652:1268-1276,2006.

name: CANGAROO-III observes the supernova remnant RX J0852.0-4622 and confirms the H.E.S.S. results

summary.plain: With three of its telescopes in January and February 2005, CANGAROO-III observed the supernova remnant RX J0852.0-4622 and confirmed the shell shape and energy spectrum that H.E.S.S. had reported.
summary.technical: CANGAROO-III observations in January and February 2005 with three telescopes, using three-fold coincidence data: the morphology and energy spectrum confirm H.E.S.S., and the spectrum in the north-west rim is consistent with that of the whole remnant.

title: CANGAROO-III Observations of the supernova remnant RX J0852.0-4622
why_it_matters: The abstract notes that sub-TeV emission from the north-west rim had first been detected with the CANGAROO-II telescope and then confirmed by H.E.S.S..
